INVESTIGATIONS OF LEUKAEMIAS
Investigations
- Full blood count with ESR, reticulocyte count, Coombs test
- Bone marrow examination
- Biochemical tests: serum electrolytes, urea, creatinine, uric acid, liver
function tests
- Prothrombin time, partial thromboplasmin human leucocyte antigen typing
- HIV I and II
- Cytochemical tests:
- Peroxidase
- Sudan Black B-Non-specific esterase reaction e.g. alpha napthyl
acetate esterase
- Bone marrow cultures
- Cytogenetic studies
- Electron microscopy
- Cell markers e.g. using a panel of antibodies combined with flow
cytometric analysis or the alkaline phosphase-anti alkaline phosphate
(APAAP) technique to classify the blast cells into lymphoid or myeloid
lineages
- Abdominal ultrasound/CT scans
- Immunological classification
- Terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase demonstration in nuclei of B and T
lymphocytes
